comparison: Establishes the first official Axiom baseline on four-laws-adherence-v1 (research_diagnostic scope only, zero ordinary qualification credit) and highlights the exact Law 1-4 frontiers for axiom-v5.
conclusion: 22/33 diagnostic PASS on four-laws-adherence-v1: passes 19/24 curated Forge anchors plus 3/9 new adversarial dynamical falsification probes (fl_law2_pure_adversarial_codim1, fl_law42_swap_deep_critic_16l, fl_law42_deep_resbn_and_conv1x1); honest diagnostic FAILs remain on the 6 hardest high-D/aniso/noisy/rare-tail/GroupNorm-ViT probes and 5 anchors.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Unchanged global axiom-v4 outperforms unchanged unified-v14 across the 20 curated anchors and 9 public-API dynamical Four Laws probes in four-laws-adherence-v1 under protocol seed 0, passing high-D R^32 orphan mixtures, swapped 16L deep critics, codimension-1 thin circles, and isomorphic 4D 1x1 Conv2d ResBN twins.
next_action: Use the 6 failing fl_* probes to drive clean-slate Law 1-4 upgrades in axiom-v5.
